translation:
Registration for Credit in the Graduate Module-Specific "Master's/Doctoral Seminar" (석박세미나) Courses, 2nd Semester 2026 (Current Students / Students Taking the Course for Credit)
Posted: 3 August 2026

This notice concerns registration for credit (수강) in the graduate module-specific "Master's/Doctoral Seminar" (석박세미나) courses for the 2nd semester of 2026.
Current students who have completed auditing (청강) and wish to take the course for credit must register for the course during the period below.

1. Overview of the graduate module-specific "Master's/Doctoral Seminar"
- This is a mandatory requirement for completing the master's and doctoral programmes. The master's and doctoral seminars for each module are offered every semester, and you must take the seminar of your own module before completion.
- The seminar runs over two semesters. In the first semester, you audit (청강) without registering. In the second semester, you register for the course and give a presentation in English (수강신청 및 영어 발표) to earn 3 credits.
- Integrated master's-doctoral programme students must complete both the Master's Seminar (석사세미나) and the Doctoral Seminar (박사세미나), based on entering the doctoral stage in the 4th semester.
  · Master's Seminar: audit in semester 1 → register and present in semester 2 (3 credits)
  · Doctoral Seminar: audit in semester 4 → register and present in semester 5 (3 credits)
  ※ In the first semester (semester 1 or semester 4), you do not formally register; you attend as an auditor only.

2. Course registration schedule
[The schedule is not given in the text of the notice. It may appear in an image or in Attachment 1, which was not read.]

3. English Presentation Skills Seminar (details will be announced later)
- Date, time and place: Friday, 4 September 2026, 2:00–3:00 p.m., planned to be held online (Zoom)
- Content: a lecture on English presentation skills
- Note: Attendance is not mandatory for auditing students. Only those who wish to attend may apply. Attendance is recommended in the semester in which you take the course for credit.

4. Important notes
A. Courses with the same name other than the 16 courses listed in [Attachment 2] are not the required Master's/Doctoral Seminar. They are recognised as general graduate courses (their subtitle code/subtitle name (부제코드/부제명) is different).
B. In the first semester, the module-specific Master's/Doctoral Seminar is taken by auditing (청강). Take care not to formally register for the course during the registration period in that semester.
C. You must register for the course offered by the module to which you (through your academic advisor) belong. You may register for the course offered under the same subtitle name (부제명) as the course you previously audited.
  ※ [Exception for Master's Seminars, 2nd Semester of 2026]
  · Applies to: only the Master's Seminars of the 'Semiconductor' (반도체) and 'Computer' (컴퓨터) modules, for which courses have been added this semester
  · Period: 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year only
  · Exception: Even if the subtitle name does not match that of the course you audited last semester, you may register for the course that corresponds to your presentation topic.
D. In principle, auditing and taking the course for credit must be done in two consecutive semesters. If you unavoidably cannot do them consecutively, you must report this to the teaching assistant in charge in advance, so that the teaching assistant does not omit it when handing over duties. Please note that if any problem arises, the student is responsible.

5. Enquiries: the department office (학부사무실), Building 301, Room 319. The contact details are in the original notice.
